name: Auto Taxonomy Term Translation
description: Extends Auto Node Translate to taxonomy terms: a per-term Automatic Translation form and a per-vocabulary bulk translate form that machine-translate term fields into the chosen languages.
project_description:
This module provides the ability to individually add automatic translations to taxonomy terms or translate a full vocabulary using external libraries.

 
 
 
 This is a sub-module of Auto Node Translate . 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Normal module installation procedure. 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 Auto Node Translate 

 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 For version 1 Configure the Automatic Translation at (/admin/config/auto_node_translate/config).

 For version 2 Configure the Automatic Translation at (/admin/config/regional/auto-node-translate-settings).

 
 Back to top 

 Using 
 
 Choose an API in the settings page. 
 Create a translatable custom block, in any language. 
 Click on the "Automatic Translation" tab. 
 Choose the language(s) you want to translate to. 
 This module will create or update the translations of the selected languages, automatically translating all text fields.
